messages.subject: quantile regression for continuous dependent variable
parts:
Hi, 
I want to construct a quantile regression for a continuous skewed dependent variable that includes 0. Can someone tell me which families in inla support this?
Thank you!

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] quantile regression for continuous dependent variable
parts:
if Y is a variable that is skewed, then exp(Y) > 0 and skewed. the quantiles
are mapped accordingly, so you should be fine. then gamma distribution comes to
mind, which includes the quantile link
